name: What is the difference between a minor kitchen upgrade and a full kitchen remodel?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a minor kitchen upgrade and a full kitchen remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: A minor upgrade refreshes existing elements, while a full remodel strips the room down to reconfigure the layout or replace all core components. Minor upgrades typically include repainting walls, replacing cabinet hardware, or adding a new tile backsplash. A full remodel involves gutting cabinets, running new drywall, replacing countertops, and frequently adjusting plumbing or electrical lines. The trade-off comes down to cost and timeline: cosmetic refreshes take days and leave your layout intact, while full remodels require several weeks of site work, trade coordination, and living without a functional kitchen.
acceptedAnswer.description: A minor upgrade updates cosmetic features like tile or paint, while a full remodel involves replacing cabinets, rerouting utilities, and altering the floor plan.
